name: us-schedule-e-rental-income
description: Compute 2026 Schedule E Part I for an individual's residential or commercial rental real estate: rents, repairs, the split of land and building, straight-line depreciation over 27.5 years (residential) or 39 years (nonresidential) with the mid-month convention, the section 280A vacation-home tests, and the section 469 passive loss limit including the USD 25,000 active-participation allowance and Form 8582. Trigger on "Schedule E", "rental income", "vacation home", "27.5 year depreciation", "39 year property", "Form 8582", "passive loss allowance". Real estate professional status and the seven-day rental rule are in us-real-estate-professional-and-short-term-rentals. A rental of fewer than 15 days is in us-augusta-rule-home-rental-to-your-business. Federal only.
